mechanism: An autonomous research pipeline with four stages: (1) Planning - decompose query into research questions, (2) Multi-Round Search - iteratively search, identify gaps, refine queries, (3) {{synthesis}} - integrate findings across sources, resolve contradictions, (4) Report - generate an analytical report with citations. Loops between search and synthesis until a round surfaces nothing new or the round bound is reached. Chains {{discover}} for breadth and {{retrieval_augment}} for depth, orchestrated by {{deep}}.
failure_modes: Source {{cognitive_bias}}: Over-relying on first sources found.
{{synthesis}} Hallucination: Inventing connections not in sources.
Premature Closure: Stopping search before finding contradicting evidence.
invariants: Findings are synthesized across sources that do not derive from one another.
More than one search round; the value is in the gap-detection between them.
Every claim in the report names the sources it rests on.
The loop ends on a dry round or the round bound, and which one is recorded.
preconditions: A question that one source cannot settle
postconditions: A report in which each claim names its sources
The reason the loop stopped is recorded
